description: The procedure the single agent follows. The scripts derive the current step from what they really did and print the next call in a JOURNAL line (scripts/_journal.py).
steps: LOCATE: locate.py with the names and error text of the statement
UNDERSTAND: hints.py with the key words of the statement, then show.py [file, symbol] on the code to change
EDIT: edit.py [file, start, end, new lines] with the line numbers shown
VERIFY: check.py []; if it undoes a breaking edit, go back to EDIT
SUBMIT: the submit_patch tool, then one sentence naming the files and the change
